inputPolicy: Use only the independent pypdf visible original vertices and labeled clipping endpoints; do not read private off-axis paths or the PDF again.
checks: Verify published source-manifest hash and every frozen Git blob against its pin
Verify result source commit, analysis-source hash, root input hash and independent extraction hash
Verify curve attribution, original versus clipping semantics, shared support and positive centerlines
Reconstruct the two independent pypdf polylines and verify every saved union knot and signed difference
Find maximum absolute discrepancy over the independent union knots and every maximizing knot
Integrate x times squared difference and x times squared Offboard 2 reference with two-point and three-point Gauss-Legendre on each union interval
Enumerate every half-centerline intersection and plateau; verify direction and uniqueness without assuming monotonicity
Verify null experimental confidence intervals and null physical pass threshold
quadratureRationale: Each profile is affine on a union interval, so both weighted-square integrands are cubic there. Gauss quadrature is independent of the author's polynomial-antiderivative implementation.
limits: Descriptive reanalysis of exposed displayed medians only
No root analysis imports or original analyzer rerun
No new physical data, fit, confidence interval, significance or rejection verdict
No physical validation or novelty claim
No source paper, figure image, hidden path coordinates or local private paths in public handoff
